title: Custom NFC Cards
description: Custom NFC cards for business cards, hotel keys, membership, review prompts and branded tap interactions, with NTAG and other 13.56 MHz chip options.
summary: Custom NFC cards combine a familiar card shape with tap-based interactions for business profiles, reviews, memberships, hotel programs and branded campaigns.
ProudTek make NFC card with specially attractive material such wood, stainless steel, PET, etc.
Unlike traditional business cards, NFC cards can link to a digital profile that includes contact details, social media links, portfolios, videos, and more.

faq.question: What are Custom NFC Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for branded tap interactions across business cards, hotel keys, review cards, memberships and promotional campaigns that need a familiar card shape.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for Custom NFC Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: Ntag213/215/216 Protocol: ISO/IEC 14443-3 Frequency: 13.56mhz Read Range: 2-5cm

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for Custom NFC Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, RPVC, PET, PETG, ABS, PC, Paper, Wood, Metal, etc. Form Factor: Card format compatible with common access-control, ID, or NFC workflows. Dimensions: 86.5x54x0.86mm (Credit Card Size)
